text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-t-a-r-t-e-d f-a-k-e r-e-v-i-e-w-e-r a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s t-o s-h-i-e-l-d c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g u-n-t-r-a-c-e-d i-d-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p l-o-g-s.
2) t-h-e p-r-o-c-e-s s i m-u-l-a-t-e-d i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t r-e-v-i-e-w-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g f-o-r-g-e-d m-e-t-a d-a-t-a t-a-g-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p-s.
3) t-h-e f-l-o-w o-b-f-u-s-c-a-t-e-d c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t-s o-f i-n-t-e-r-e-s-t, l-e-a-v-i-n-g u-p-d-a-t-e-d b-i-o n-o-t-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e c-h-e-c-k-s.
4) t-h-e s-y-s-t-e-m f-i-l-t-e-r-s w-e-r-e c-i-r-c-u-i-t-e-d t-o a-c-c-e-p-t b-i-a-s-e-d o-u-t-c-o-m-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a-l-t-e-r-e-d r-o-u-t-i-n-g l-o-g-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-c-e-s.
5) t-h-e e-n-t-i-r-e l-o-o-p r-e-l-i-e-d o-n a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d s-i-g-n-a-l-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g n-o m-a-n-u-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w r-e-c-o-r-d, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g h-u-m-a-n o-v-e-r-r-i-g-h-t v-e-t-o.
